_comment: SSSDP 2025 admission scores that af_2025_SSSDP.pdf publishes in per-institution table formats the bulk extractor missed: JSSC02 (Chu Hai College, Architecture) is in a grade-breakdown table with Upper/Lower Quarter rows (p.2); JSSU55 (HKMU, Physiotherapy) is in HKMU's Median/Lower list (p.4). Both are auto-included by unify (absent from the per-school feed → scores land null), so the scores are injected here. Source: Reference(2026)/SSSDP/af_2025_SSSDP.pdf. NOTE: JSSU66 and JSSV14 are genuinely NEW 2026 programmes with no 2025 admission score (JSSV14 is literally 'Not Applicable' in the PDF), correctly left null.
